title: We made 2 other games that are on our website that you can play right now
author: Silexriv
selftext:
Hi guys!

I made a post like 2 months ago showing the first game I made with AI!  
The game was called Escape Wardenfall.  
  
It was on my website where anyone can play it for free but now we just added 2 new games.

The Rot Hunters: A game where you control 4 characters and try to defend your base from waves of zombies.

Dolphin Descent: You are a Dolphin in a small action roguelite where everything try to kill you and you need to survive and go as deep as possible.

Both games are still in active development but are playable right now

I want you to try it and tell me what you think!

[https://onesitting.studio/](https://onesitting.studio/)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Silexriv could you add more about how AI fit into your development process? Just mentioning that AI was used doesn't cut it. Under Rule 4, promotional posts need to contribute something by discussing how the game was actually made. Otherwise the sub gets buried in ads. If there's no update, this post may be removed.
